description: ERRORLOG signal counters (rolling 6h via xp_readerrorlog): capacity criticals (9002/1105/112), I/O & latch, AlwaysOn redo, deadlocks, client disconnects. Filter by Server and Signal.

targets.expr: count(sum by (instance) (mssql_errorlog_signal_count{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", signal=~"${signal:regex}"}) > 0) or vector(0)

options.content:
### What this dashboard shows
`mssql_errorlog_signal_count` = count of selected ERRORLOG patterns in a **rolling ~6 hour** window (`xp_readerrorlog`, scrape every ~5m).

| Signal | Meaning | Typical action |
|---|---|---|
| `transaction_log_full_9002` | Log full (often `LOG_BACKUP` / `ACTIVE_TRANSACTION`) | Free log / take log backup / check long tx |
| `filegroup_full_1105` | Filegroup cannot allocate page | Add space / autogrowth / clean data |
| `backup_disk_full_112` | Backup device OS error 112 (disk full) | Free backup volume |
| `slow_io` | I/O taking longer than 15s | Storage / SAN / VM disk latency |
| `buffer_latch_timeout_845` | Buffer latch timeout | I/O / memory / latch contention |
| `latch_timeout` | Generic latch timeout | Correlate with waits / blocking |
| `deadlock_1205` | Deadlock victim | Trace deadlock graph / app retry |
| `4014_client_disconnect` | Client could not reuse session | Network / app pool / idle timeout |
| `network_178xx` | Network read/write errors 17828/17830 | Network path / firewall / NIC |
| `8645_memory_grant` | Memory grant timeout / wait | Memory pressure / query grants |
| `ag_suspend_from_redo` | AG data movement suspended (redo) | Fix secondary / resume AG |
| `redo_error_3313` | Redo logged-op failure | AG health / corruption check |
| `redo_worker_failure` | Redo worker failed to start | AG secondary health |

Security login failures (`18456` / disabled login) live on **mssql_security**, not here.
